messages:
Maya: Quick flag — the Launch Pulse dashboard looks off vs GA4 for the last 7 days. MQLs showing -18% but landing CTR is up. https://dash.redwood.ai/launch-pulse?cohort=apr_launch
Sam: I saw that too. My guess: attribution window mismatch. GA4 is last-click 30d; our Launch Pulse uses session-based source by default.
Leo: Also, double-check inbound routing for webinar leads — I think some were tagged incorrectly and ended up under direct.
Maya: Confirmed. Webinar UTM had campaign=Q2_launch_webinar but routing rules expect campaign=Q2launch_web (missing underscores). So ~420 leads fell through.
Jordan: Oof. Can we add a quick fallback rule to the router to capture common variants?
Sam: Yes — fallback prefix matching should fix most. But we should also add a multi-touch lens to the dashboard so the KPI story isn’t fragile to last-touch differences.
Analytics-bot: Data pull finished for cohort 'apr_launch' — totals: 1,263 leads, MQL rate (our dashboard)=14.2%, GA4 last-click MQL rate=17.4%. Raw export: s3://marketing/exports/launch_apr_202604.csv
Maya: Thanks. Can we add columns for last_touch and multi_touch_score in the export? Those will help the ops cleanup.
Leo: I’ll add the two columns to the ETL. Should be a small schema tweak.
Jordan: Proposed UTM mapping snippet to run in router as interim: 
```
# loose matching to capture common typos
if utm_campaign and utm_campaign.lower().replace('_','').startswith('q2launch'):
    campaign='q2_launch'
elif utm_campaign in ['Q2LaunchWeb','Q2_launch_webinar','q2-launch-web']:
    campaign='q2_launch_webinar'
```
Sam: That looks good. Ops will need a short window to validate side effects.
Ops_kate: Ops can deploy that script in staging today. For prod we need an annotated mapping doc and a rollback plan. Ping me when Jordan posts the mapping.
Maya: For the weekly KPI huddle: can we make this a short agenda item Wed 09:30 PT? Ask: review updated Launch Pulse numbers (before vs after fallback), confirm routing mapping, decide on tag-clean Fri.
Sam: I’ll slot it in. Also request: include a compact pre-read (1 slide) with the two key deltas (MQL delta and CTR delta) and the GA4 vs Launch Pulse table.
Leo: I’ll ship dashboard screenshots and the ETL diff.
Jordan: I’ll post the mapping doc + examples of affected lead rows. Also proposal: 2-hour Friday blitz to backfill historical tags (only for the last 30 days) — need ops signoff.
Ops_kate: 2-hr window is fine. We’ll open a change ticket and require a quick smoke test.
Maya: Owners: add to tasks — 1) Multi-touch metric on Launch Pulse (Leo), 2) Router fallback deploy (Sam + Ops_kate), 3) Mapping doc + historical tag-clean plan (Jordan). Can each owner drop a :thumbsup: if they’re good?
Sam: :thumbsup:
Leo: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Ops_kate: :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks — I’ll post the pre-read by Tue EOD and update the KPI agenda. If anyone spots other cohorts affected, @mention in this thread.
Sam: Small note on messaging: variant B for launch posts had +0.9% CTR but 2x bounce; we should surface that in the pre-read as a hypothesis for lower MQL conversion.
Leo: Good call — include landing heatmaps and scroll depth.
Maya: Great. Closing loop — expected outcomes for Wed: clear delta, signoff on router fallback, and go/no-go for Friday clean.
Jordan: Will upload mapping doc in ~30m.
Analytics-bot: Export uploaded: s3://marketing/exports/launch_apr_202604_mapped.csv
Maya: perfect, thanks everyone.
